purpose: Teach: そぐわない/優劣/ケープ/コロニー/歌人/死人/ビジネスチャンス/スンニ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、伝統に「そぐわない」改革の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on reforms that don't align with tradition and the sociology around that, didn't you?
lines.style: Measured, genuinely curious. Leans slightly forward. Warm enough to put him at ease, but precise — she's checking she understood his work correctly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、教育評価で優劣を付ける弊害の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the research about the harms of ranking students in educational evaluation.
lines.style: Direct but not clipped. A small breath before the clarification. He's correcting gently, not defensively. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、南アフリカのケープタウン、つまりケープ植民史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, and you wrote about Cape Town in South Africa — about the colonial history of the Cape, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before 'correct.' She's genuinely recalling, not testing. Interested in the geography and historical weight of his choice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦前の植民地、つまりコロニーの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about colonial research, specifically on the pre-war colonial period and the structures of colonialism itself.
lines.style: Slightly more careful here. He's clarifying terminology. Quiet precision. A little tension around 'structures' — he wants to be exact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、現代歌人の作品研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on contemporary poets and their work, wasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, like she's genuinely turning this over. Slight lift at the end — not interrogative, but inviting confirmation of her memory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、刑法における死人、つまり死人の名誉毀損の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — actually I researched defamation law as it applies to the deceased, specifically around protection of the dead person's reputation.
lines.style: Quieter correction this time. He's aware this is unexpected. Gentle but firm — this matters to him. No apology in the delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新興市場のビジネスチャンスの研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you researched emerging market opportunities in business, didn't you?
lines.style: Same warm attentiveness as before. A gentle rhythm — she's clearly worked through this list before. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中東のスンニ派、つまりスンニ系コミュニティの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on research about Sunni communities in the Middle East and their place in these markets.
lines.style: Final line: steady but softer. He's explained himself repeatedly now. A small exhale of relief to finish. Present but quieter.
